summary: Full backend + frontend E2E test of NervenPfad. Backend 19/20 pytest pass (only failure: unescaped regex in ?q= -> 500). Frontend: all requested flows work: 3D canvas, layer toggles, view buttons, auto-rotate, slider, search/quick-symptoms/evidence filters, detail panel (zahn-13 with agenesis/tcm/claims/technique/contraindication/related/studies), related chip navigation, dental chart (select, mark-missing toggle, default 13 missing, show-chain-btn -> 3D + chain entry + Seite view), PubMed live search + prefill, admin login/error, entry table/filter, create/edit/delete via dialog, drop-in upload + import with error report, pubmed-add + duplicate toast, remove-study, logout. No page errors.

minor.issue: User input passed raw into Mongo $regex -> 500 (re.error) for chars like '(' '[' '*' '+'. Fix: use re.escape(q) in list_entries.

Brute-force lockout identifier uses request.client.host which is the ingress pod IP (varies: saw 10.30.130.133 and 10.30.132.109 for same client). 7 bad attempts gave 7x401, no 429. Use X-Forwarded-For first IP or key by email only.
Negative idx (e.g. -1) not rejected -> removes last study. Validate idx >= 0.
Changing code to an already existing code raises DuplicateKeyError -> 500 instead of 400.
Returns 200 even if entry doesn't exist (no 404).

If a study row fails validation mid-file (e.g. missing title), the exception aborts the file after earlier rows were already pushed; file is not moved -> re-import duplicates earlier rows. Validate per row and continue.

ui_bugs.issue: Default tradition is 'TCM' and color '#D96C50' for every new entry, even when layer is Nervensystem - easily saves wrong tradition badge.
show-chain-btn appears for any missing canine (13/23/33/43) but always opens the zahn-13 chain. Also missingTeeth.sort() mutates state array during render.

issues: Teeth (32 entries) are hidden from the entry list unless a search term is typed ('45 Treffer' of 77) - intentional but not communicated; evidence filter without query also excludes teeth.

design_issues.issue_note: Query 'canine agenesis' returns veterinary (dog) papers first; seed/pubmed_query for tooth 13 should use 'maxillary canine agenesis' or 'permanent canine tooth agenesis'.

action_items: Escape regex in GET /api/entries q param (re.escape) to avoid 500
Fix brute-force identifier to use X-Forwarded-For (or email) so lockout works behind ingress
Validate idx>=0 in remove_study; return 400 on duplicate code in PUT; 404 on delete of missing entry
Make drop-in import resilient per row
Optional: better defaults in EntryEditor (tradition by layer), chain button only for tooth 13 or per-canine chain
critical_code_review_comments: server.py list_entries: raw $regex from user input (500 + ReDoS risk)
Login lockout keyed by proxy IP - ineffective in k8s
Entry responses expose '_id' as string (acceptable, serialized via alias) - fine
PUT replaces whole studies array with editor's copy: if a study is added from dashboard while admin editor is open with stale data, it gets overwritten
test_credentials: admin@nervenpfad.de / Nerven2026! (from /app/memory/test_credentials.md) - works. bcrypt $2b$ verified, httpOnly cookies set, CORS explicit origin + credentials verified, seed_admin only inserts if missing.

Teeth only appear in left list when searching (e.g. 'Zahn 13'). Window.confirm on admin delete - accept dialog in playwright. Brute-force test: use fake email to avoid locking admin.
rca of the issue: Regex 500: list_entries builds {'$regex': q} directly; Mongo rejects invalid patterns like '(' -> OperationFailure -> 500. Lockout: request.client.host = ingress pod IP, multiple pods -> counter split across identifiers.
